mapper.sql: uri_path, screen_id, primary_table, related_tables, data_type, table_desc, reg_id, reg_dt, update_id, update_dt
mapper.select: SELECT FROM screen_table_map ORDER BY uri_path
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO screen_table_map ( uri_path, screen_id, primary_table, related_tables, data_type, table_desc, reg_id, reg_dt, update_id, update_dt ) VALUES ( #{uriPath}, #{screenId}, #{primaryTable}, #{relatedTables}, #{dataType}, #{tableDesc}, #{regId}, #{regDt}, #{updateId}, #{updateDt} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE screen_id = VALUES(screen_id), primary_table = VALUES(primary_table), related_tables = VALUES(related_tables), data_type = VALUES(data_type), table_desc = VALUES(table_desc), update_id = VALUES(update_id), update_dt = VALUES(update_dt)
